newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, OCTOBER 22 - THURSDAY, OCTOBER 24.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, OCTOBER 22 - THURSDAY, OCTOBER 24.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-222/95 Parodi: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 59 and 61, paragraph 2. National legislation requiring approval to offer banking services according mortgage loans before the implementation of Council directive 89/646/EEC amending directive 77/780/EEC of December 12, 1977, co-ordinating laws, regulations and administrative provisions relating to the taking up and pursuit of the business of credit institutions and amending Council directive 77/780/EEC. - (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-336/94 Dafeki: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 6, 48 and 51 of EC treaty. Probative force of civil status documents. Establishment of date of birth to determine old age pension rights. - (1530/1330 GMT) C-177/95 Ebony Maritime: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of ECSC decision 93/235 by member state government representatives of April 26, 1993, on trade between the EU and the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (Serbia and Montenegro) and of regulation 990/93 of April 26, 1993, on trade between the EU and the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (Serbia and Montenegro). Seizure of vessel in international waters carrying goods apparently intended for commercial trade in Yugoslav territorial waters.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-1/95 Gerster: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 119 and Council directive 75/117/EEC of February 10, 1975, on the approximation of the laws of member states on the application of the principle of equal pay for men and women as well as Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Calculation of seniority for promotional reasons in public office. Consideration of periods of part time work. - Opinion C-100/95 Kording: social policy. Interpretation of article 3, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Access to profession of tax advisor. Exemption from examination for tax administration officials in their functions for at least 15 years. Calculation of the length of experience acquired by a part-time worker. Part-time workers principally women.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-154/94 CSF and CSME v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of February 7, 1994, on the Dutch governments aid to the FRIMA company. Construction of a salt production unit. Refusal to open a procedure provided for in article 93, paragraph 2. Margin of Commission appreciation. Commission resolution of October 20, 1971. - Judgment T-266/94 Skibsvaerftsforeningen v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision forming the subject of the May 11, 1994, press release authorising the release of the second tranche of aid for the Meerestechnik Werft naval works. - Judgment T-330/94 Salt Union v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of August 5, 1994 on the Dutch government's aid to the FRIMA company. Construction of a salt production unit. Refusal to open a procedure provided for in article 93, paragraph 2. Margin of Commission appreciation. Commission resolution of October 20, 1971. - Judgment T-79/95 SNCF v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision 94/894 of December 13, 1994, on an application procedure for EC treaty article 85 and article 53 of the EEA accord (Eurotunnel). Exemption granted to the "Use Convention" (concerning the use of the channel tunnel). - Judgment T-80/95 British Railways Board v/ commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision 94/894 of December 13, 1994, on an application procedure for EC treaty article 85 and article 53 of the EEA accord (Eurotunnel). Exemption granted to the "Use Convention" (concerning the use of the channel tunnel).

FOURTH CHAMBER (0945/0745 GMT) - Oral procedure T-49/95 Van Megen Sports Group v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 21, 1994, on an application procedure for article 85 of the EC treaty. Obstacles to parallel exports of Tretorn tennis balls.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-59/95 Bastos Moriana: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 77, paragraph 2(b) and 78, paragraph 2(b), 79, paragraph 1 and 94, paragraph 5 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Benefits for children in the charge of pension holders or benefit recipients under the legislation of several member states. Right to a complement when benefits in the state of residence are inferior to those provided by the legislation of other states involved. - Opinion C-169/95 Spain v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of March 14, 1995, on investment aids granted by the Spanish government to the company Piezas y Rodajes SA. Grant answering conditions of a regional aid system previously approved by the Commission. Obligation to repay an aid approved at a prior stage by the Commission.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-335/95 Picard: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 36, paragraphs 1, 2, 3 and 4 of Council regulation 574/72 of March 21, 1972, laying down modes of application of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU. Old age pension. Request not respecting the rules of article 36, paragraphs 1-3, designating the authority to whom the request must be submitted. - Opinion C-255/95 S. Agri: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 3(c) of Council regulation 797/85 of March 12, 1985, on the improvement of agricultural structures. Aids towards the expansion of bovine meat production. Conditions for granting. Bovines - reduction of livestock. - Opinion C-273/95 Buratti: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 10 to 12 of Commission regulation 3478/92 of December 1, 1992, laying down detailed rules for the application of the premium system for raw tobacco. Granting of premiums for leaf tobacco. Date of delivery. Producers co-operative or processing company.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-86/94 De Venhorst: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 3, paragraph 1 of Council directive 88/408/EEC of June 15, 1988, on the levels of the fees to be charged for health inspections and controls of fresh meat pursuant to Council directive 85/73/EEC. Slaughtered chicken. Meats to be boned for cuts. - Judgment C-172/95 Sucriere agricole de Maizy: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 8, of Council regulation 1785/81 of June 30, 1981, on the common organisation of markets in the sugar sector and of article 12 of Commission regulation 1998/78 of August 18, 1978, laying down detailed rules on the offsetting of storage costs for sugar and of article 6 of regulation 1358/77, of June 20, 1977, laying down general rules on compensation for storage costs in the sugar sector and abrogating regulation 750/68. Taxable event. Interpretation of article 32A of Council regulation 934/86 of March 24, 1986, amending regulation 1785/81 on the common organisation of markets in the sugar sector and of regulation 1914/87 of July 2, 1987, laying down a special resorption fee in the sugar sector of the 1986/1987 marketing campaign. Taxable event. - Opinion C-105/95 Daut: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Interpretation of Council directive 64/433/EEC of June 26, 1964, on health problems affecting intra-community trade in fresh meat as amended and codified by directive 91/497/EEC. Interpretation of directive 77/99/EEC on health problems affecting intra-community trade in meat products as amended and codified by directive 92/5/EEC. Restriction on intra-community trade in meats mechanically cut up and not subjected to thermal treatment. Production hygiene conditions and marketing.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-321/94 to C-324/94 Pistre: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36 of Council regulation 2081/92 of July 14, 1992, on the protection of geographical indications and designations of origin for agricultural products and foodstuffs. National law subjecting the use of the attribution "mountain" to ministerial authorisation. Cold cuts. - Opinion C-352/95 Phytheron International: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Parallel imports of a phytosanitary product of extra-community origin, homologued and protected by an identical brand name in the two member states concerned. - Oral procedure C-13/96 Bic Benelux: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, points 1 and 5 of Council directive 83/189/EEC of March 28, 1983, laying down a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations as amended by directive 88/182 of March 22, 1988. Notions of "technical specifications" and "technical rules" - distinctive mark indicating that a product has been subject to an ecotax and the amount of this ecotax or the cause of exemption or amount of deposit. - Oral procedure C-220/95 Van den Boogaard: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 2, no. 1 of the Brussels Convention. Matrimonial arrangements. Decision on livelihood obligations between spouses involving the transfer of a part of assets.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-329/93, C-62/95 and C-63/95 Germany and others v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision 93/412 of April 6, 1993, on a German government aid to the company Bremer Vulkan AG. - Judgment C-435 Dietz: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 119 of EC treaty. Private retirement pension arrangements declared compulsory. Rights of a woman excluded from arrangements to be retroactively affiliated. Effect of limitation in time order by the Court in its Barber judgment. Effects of the Maastricht treaty (protocol relative to article 199 of EC treaty) on a suit introduced in 1992. - Judgment C-217/94 Eismann Alto Adige: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 22, paragraph 8 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment as amended by Council directive 91/680/EEC of December 16, 1991, supplementing the common system of value added tax and amending Directive 77/388/EEC/EEC with a view to the abolition of fiscal frontiers. National measures to ensure the exact collection of VAT and fraud avoidance. Need for an accompanying document (Bolla d'accompagnamento) for goods transport inside a member state. Door to door sales. - Judgment C-288/94 Argos Distributors: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 11A, paragraph 3(b) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Taxable basis. Reductions and coupons. Coupons sold cut-price by a supplier to distributors likely to recover the full normal sale price in retail. - Judgment C-317/94 Elida Gibbs Ltd: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 11A, paragraph l(a) and 11C, paragraph 1 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Taxable basis. Money-off coupons. Coupons printed on packaging of goods and providing for a repayment of part of purchase price ("cash-back coupons"). - Judgment C-32/95-P Commission v/ Lisrestal: social policy. Appeal against Court judgment (first chamber) of December 6, 1994, in case T-450/93, Lisrestal and others v/ Commission. Judgment reducing the European Social Fund's contribution to a professional training programme. - Judgment C-72/95 Aannemersbedrijf P.K. Kraaijeveld BV v/ Gedeputeerde Staten van Zuid-Holland: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 85/337/EEC of June 27, 1985, on the assessment of the effects of certain public and private projects on the environment. Interpretation of the notion of "canalisation and normalisation waterways works". Works related to a dike along a river. Competence of a national judge called to apply a national legislation transposing a community directive. - Judgment C-73/95-P Vine Europe v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber) rendered January 12, 1995, in case T-102/92, VIHO Europe v/ Commission of September 30, 1992, rejecting VIHO's claim relating to a breach of article 85, paragraph 1 of EC treaty on the part of Parker Pen. Obligation imposed by a parent company on its subsidiaries to remain within their distribution zones. - Judgment C-76/95 Commission v/ Royale belge: company law. Appeal based on arbitration clause. Insurance contract aimed at covering sums paid under article 73 of statute of officials. Possibility for the insurer to question the regularity of an opinion pronounced by the medical commission. - Judgment C-91/95-P Tremblay v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (second chamber) rendered January 24, 1995, in case T-5/93, R. Tramblay and others v/ Commission. Annulment of Commission decision of November 12, 1992, in that it refers the dossier to national jurisdiction. - Judgment C-325/95 Commission v/ Ireland: agriculture. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 91/67/EEC of January 28, 1991, on the animal health conditions governing the placing on the market of aquaculture animals and products, 91/492/EEC of July 15, 1991, laying down the health conditions for the production and the placing on the market of live bivalve molluscs, 91/493/EEC of July 22, 1991, laying down the health conditions for the production and the placing on the market of fishery products and 92/48/EEC of June 16, 1992, laying down the minimum hygiene rules applicable to fishery products caught on board certain vessels in accordance with article 3 (1)(a)(i) of directive 91/493/EEC. - Opinion joined cases C-304/94, C-330/94, C-342/94 and C-224/95 Tombesi: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 91/156/EEC amending directive 75/442/EEC of July 15, 1975, on waste, directive 91/689/EEC of December 12, 1991, on dangerous waste and Council regulation 259/93 of February 1, 1993, on the inspection and control of waste transfer in and out of the EU. Notion of "waste". "waste intended to be refined", reusable waste. - Opinion C-134/95 USSL no. 47 de Biella: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 48, 49, 54 and 90. National legislation that reserves job placement activities exclusively for a public monopoly. Intermediary activity of labour force by a co-operative company. Ban. - Opinion C-247/95 Marktgemeinde Welden: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 4, paragraph 1, 2 and 4, fourth line, article 5 and article 13 C, paragraph 2 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Economic activity within the meaning of the directive or operation carried out by a public law body as a public authority. Leasing of premises. - Opinion C-383/95 Rutten: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 5, point I of Brussels Convention. Work contract to be executed in several contracting states. Place where the worker normally performs his work. - Oral procedure C-91/96 commission v/ Greece: agriculture. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/118/EEC of December 17, 1992, laying down animal health and public health requirements governing trade in and import into the Community of products not subject to the said requirements laid down in specific Community rules referred to in Annex A(I) chapter 1 of Directive 89/662/EEC and, as regards pathogens, to Directive 90/425/EEC and of directive 93/52/EEC of June 24, 1993, amending directive 89/556/EEC on animal health conditions governing intra-community trade in and importation from third countries of embryos of domestic animals of the bovine species. - Oral procedure C-190/95 A-RO Lease: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9, paragraph 1 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Place of performance of a service. Notion of "stable establishment" Making available to third parties in a member state, on the basis of operational leasing contracts, cars bought in that state by a company established in another member state. - (1100/0900 GMT) C-167/95 Linthorst, Pouwels en Scheren: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. offering of a service. Vet established in one member state, practising in another member state.
ALL SAINTS' DAY COURT RECESS, FRIDAY, OCTOBER 25-FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 1.
